measurement_notes.scope: Fictional sample products and synthetic size charts for recommendation development; these are not actual inventory or manufacturer specifications.
measurement_notes.units: Every measurement is in inches. Measurements describe the finished garment, not a wearer or a body-size range.
measurement_notes.circumferences: waist, hip, thigh, chest, hem, and upper_arm are full circumferences, never flat widths. Elastic waists are measured relaxed and unstretched.
measurement_notes.pants: waist is the waistband circumference; hip is the circumference at the fullest seat; thigh is one leg circumference just below the crotch; inseam runs from the crotch seam to the leg hem.
measurement_notes.tops: chest is circumference below the armholes; hem is the bottom-opening circumference; shoulder_width runs straight between shoulder seams; sleeve_length runs from shoulder seam to cuff or sleeve edge; length runs from back neck to hem; upper_arm is one sleeve circumference below the armhole.
measurement_notes.sizing: Size labels are identifiers, not body measurements. Each product has its own size chart. Numeric pant labels indicate nominal waist size; use the actual measurements for comparisons.
measurement_notes.fit: Garment ease depends on intended fit, fabric, stretch, and layering. Stretch descriptions are qualitative; no stretch allowance has been added to the listed dimensions. Drop-shoulder tops shift length from the sleeve to the shoulder, so sleeve_length alone does not describe arm coverage.
measurement_notes.rendering: 3D construction dimensions, colors, and details are illustrative defaults. Original finished-garment dimensions remain in each size.measurements. Supplemental dimensions in size.render_dimensions are synthetic inches; they are not manufacturer specifications. The preview is a posed geometric approximation, not a fabric or fit simulation.
